    "Attempt-01 R1-R3 are resolved in the inspected code: metadata is parsed as one JSON object and serialized; cancelled/failed choices leave an explicit typed source; dictionary previews summarize file bytes instead of exposing them; file selection is refused while confirmation holds the editor, and stale context/file tokens cannot authorize an old payload. The source inventory is identical to the just-reviewed C09 attempt-03 tree. Verified the supplied C09 receipt and request/verdict/raw-output hashes: it is a passing predecessor with all five scores at 9.",
    "Retained check logs report 303 frontend tests and 87 core unit tests passing. Scoped logs report 10 DLP integration, 110 overlapping frontend, 8 overlapping changes-unit, 15 Runtime-change integration and 44 controller tests passing. Mutation evidence reports 18 of 19 mutations rejected and four baselines passing; the survivor is explicitly noted in O1.",
    "The current C10 native record reports 10 passing checks against executable SHA-256 339a61046565d5c339c020d8aa6980863007571f342b730a640f018c3f57a813.
